title: Every canon safeguard in one command center.
use_cases: Use when establishing a centralized command center for world-building and lore management
Implement when needing automated continuity guardrails to prevent narrative conflicts
Configure when organizing characters, factions, and locations into a searchable database
Use when tracking quest objectives, rewards, and multi-arc timelines in a single console
Apply when reviewing AI-assisted lore suggestions before final project publication
content:
How the flow works

Organize lore, orchestrate quests, and review guardrails - all with optional LoreFoundry Core support that keeps your team in complete control.

Step 1 - Capture your world

- Call on LoreFoundry Core for starter outlines you can edit or discard.
- Tag characters, places, and factions so they stay easy to find.
- Add lore documents manually or seed them with the Genesis wizard.

Step 2 - Plan playable content

- Apply feedback directly in the quest and character editors while continuity guardrails highlight conflicts.
- Log events on a timeline to keep arcs in order.
- Map characters to locations and factions as they evolve.
- Outline quests with objectives, rewards, and status tracking.

Step 3 - Share and ship

- Track permissions and project health from one console.
- Review quests, characters, and events together inside one console.
- Review LoreFoundry Core suggestions before publishing anything.
- Set guardrails that check entries for tone and canon details.

Self-serve registration is open. Create your workspace and start capturing canon in minutes.
